drivingQuestion: What does 'they count toward his amount' mean?
outcomeNote: Rava's reading is challenged in the next unit

segments.he: וְעוֹלוֹת לוֹ מִן הַחֶשְׁבּוֹן. סָבַר רָבָא לְמֵימַר לְפִי חֶשְׁבּוֹן שְׁבוּרוֹת. אַלְמָא כֵּיוָן דְּאָמַר אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ, רִיעַ טְפֵי.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If one of them recognized some of his stones he may take them for himself, «and they count toward his amount» of stones, and the other party takes other stones accordingly. «Rava thought to say» that this means they count «toward» his «amount» of his «broken» stones. In other words, the first party takes the unbroken stones he recognized, in place of a similar amount of broken stones, and the other party takes an amount of broken stones correspond-ing to the amount of unbroken stones claimed by the first person. «Apparently, since he said: I don’t know,» his legal status «is worse.»
